title: Up Close
description: In 2024, Terria Clay snapped this close-up photo of a toco toucan's eye at the Bronx Zoo in New York. The bird is the largest member of the toucan family and native to South America's rainforests. The Wildlife Conservation Society photographer tells National Geographic that this image is a reminder for us all to pay attention to small details like the striking colors and texture of this bird's eyes.
translated_description: 2024年，泰瑞亚·克莱在纽约布朗克斯动物园拍下了这张托哥巨嘴鸟眼睛的特写照片。这种鸟是巨嘴鸟家族中体型最大的成员，原产于南美洲的热带雨林。这位野生动物保护协会的摄影师告诉《国家地理》，这张照片提醒我们所有人，要留意像这只鸟眼睛上引人注目的色彩和纹理这样微小的细节。
